The diff touches no doc file; docs/exit-codes.md is not among the 7 changed files, so the documented contract is stale relative to the new behavior.
advisory.finding: The `verify-completion` verb and `close` completion gate now return exit 11 (retryable) for an insufficiency-only FAIL (top-level `evidence_sufficient=false`), but the documented CLI exit-code contract in docs/exit-codes.md still enumerates that case as an ordinary FAIL returning 1 — the wire/CLI exit-code contract changed without updating its documented consumer contract.
scenarios: A caller scripting `rebar verify-completion` per the documented contract treats exit 1 as a hard 'criteria unmet' block; an insufficiency-only FAIL that previously exited 1 now exits 11, changing the scripted disposition.
A close-gate consumer relying on docs/exit-codes.md line 245 ('ordinary completion FAIL remains 1') sees 11 for an insufficiency-only FAIL.
advisory.suggested_fix: Amend docs/exit-codes.md line 194 to add `evidence_sufficient=false -> 11` and revise line 245 so 'ordinary completion FAIL remains 1' excludes the insufficiency-only class (which now maps to the retryable 11).
